final_user_goal: Build a new reproducible A-share AI-Core growth/trend strategy that can later enter a genuine prospective First60 experiment, without pretending to recover the lost V2.7.3 strategy.
hard_constraints: new strategy identity must be explicit; no claim of continuity with lost V2.7.3 numerical strategy rules
official Forward Certified Universe remains the membership authority
AI-Core eligibility is a separate evidence layer and cannot be inferred from price strength, ticker tags, sector labels, or hindsight winners
technical/entry features cannot self-declare Evidence eligibility or official membership
all historical work before a future activation is Development/Diagnostic/Retro Stress only
outcome uses common joint A-share trading calendar and frozen D+10 target semantics unless a separately versioned comparator is explicitly tested
economic returns use the frozen economic-price/vintage rule; raw-close corporate-action artifacts cannot define promotion
no historical event may be promoted merely because it resembles a profitable pattern
all strategy rules, code, datasets/receipts, evaluator logic and decision rules must be Git-frozen before prospective activation
soft_constraints_removed: reuse old B3 chain because it existed
force a complete trading strategy before testing individual modules
make Market State an immediate hard veto
make RS/Ret20 an automatic Grade-A promotion key
choose fixed stop/take-profit/position percentages before A-share evidence supports them
require full-market PDF materialization before technical research
optimize toward a single historical headline return

architecture.Delete: Discard the failed B3_ABLATION/B3_CHAIN rule family as a promotion candidate; retain only as negative-control evidence.
architecture.Avoid: Do not create hard thresholds before module-level evidence exists.
architecture.Absorb: Reuse V2.7.31 Universe, V2.7.30 materialization, V2.7.32 First60 ledger, calendar, PIT and economic-price governance.
architecture.Substitute: Use explicit research factor families + walk-forward validation instead of reconstructed legacy strategy rules.
architecture.Precompute_Reuse: Build one canonical feature panel and one canonical outcome panel, then evaluate many preregistered candidate transforms without repeatedly reacquiring data.
architecture.Optimize: Only optimize implementation/runtime after factor definitions, leakage checks and evaluation protocol are frozen.

negative_control.policy: B3 family may be retained as a comparator/negative control but cannot seed a hard gate without new evidence.
